svg.title: Tech stack as an orbital system
svg.desc: A glowing core star labelled Python with three tilted orbits. Backend orbit: FastAPI, Flask, Django, .NET Web API, Express. Cloud and DevOps orbit: AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, GitHub Actions, Azure, Heroku. Frontend and languages orbit: React, JavaScript, Angular, TypeScript, C#/.NET, Swift, Vue. Planets pass in front of and behind the star. Star catalogue below lists AWS services, data, testing, observability and AI tools.
svg.text: Python is the star everything orbits.
